cards.review_notes: The official page gives Pre-K through grade 8 for ESP generally, rather than a summer-specific eligibility statement. Check summer eligibility, drop-off sites, dates, hours, fees and registration links when summer materials appear. The $50 weekly fee, sliding scale, sibling and employee discounts, home-school locations and Pre-K capacity currently printed on the page are explicitly for the 2026-2027 school year and have not been carried into this summer card.
